config.interpreter.path.description: Path to the Sage executable used for running files and for Sage-aware runtime context.
config.interpreter.args.description: Extra arguments passed to the Sage executable.
config.languageServer.rustPath.descripti: Path to the Rust `sage-ls` language server. Use `auto` to prefer the repository-local `target/debug/sage-ls` during local development.
config.analysis.mode.description: Workspace-wide analysis breadth. `light` returns up to 50 workspace-symbol matches, `default` up to 200, and `full` up to 1000. Navigation semantics stay identical, while diagnostics, runtime introspection, and Cython indexing remain controlled by their dedicated settings. Restart the language server after changing this setting.
config.analysis.extraPaths.description: Additional import paths supplied to the language server.
config.analysis.sourceRoots.description: Optional source roots to index before falling back to discovered workspace roots.
config.analysis.enableDiagnostics.descri: Enable diagnostics emitted by the language server.
config.analysis.enableRuntimeIntrospecti: Allow the language server to query a live Sage runtime when static indexing cannot supply docs or source locations.
config.analysis.enablePyxParsing.descrip: Enable lightweight parsing for `.pyx` files during source indexing.
config.analysis.enablePythonFiles.descri: Attach the Sage language server to ordinary `.py` files while preserving the Python language mode. Keep disabled for general Python workspaces; enable it for Sage-heavy Python projects that import from `sage.all`.
config.indexing.exclude.description: Glob patterns excluded from Sage source indexing.
config.docs.preferredSource.description: Preferred documentation source for hovers and docs panels.
config.docs.preferredSource.enum.runtime: Prefer documentation from the running Sage.
config.docs.preferredSource.enum.referen: Prefer the indexed Sage reference sources.
config.docs.showOnHover.description: Display documentation previews in hover content when available.
config.logging.level.description: Logging verbosity for the extension and language client.
config.run.target.description: Default execution target for Sage run commands.
config.run.target.enum.terminal: Run the file as a standalone Sage process in the shared task panel.
config.run.target.enum.repl: Load the file into the project's Sage REPL session.
config.run.showCellCodeLens.description: Show inline CodeLens actions for runnable `# %%` and `# region` Sage cells.
config.run.cleanupGeneratedPython.descri: After an uncontended standalone `.sage` run, remove its new `.sage.py` helper. Existing files and concurrent runs are preserved. REPL loads never delete disk helpers.
